extras: The plugin uses a complex caching system outside the vault to maintain sync performance and offers a detailed roadmap.
intentEvidence: Turn your Trakt.tv watch history into a richly localized Markdown library — with per-episode timestamps, metadata in 15+ languages, and quiet incremental sync that doesn't churn your vault.
problem: Tracking detailed media consumption data, including watch history and localized metadata, across devices within a Markdown vault is complex.

relations.evidence: This plugin was originally inspired by sarimabbas/traktr (MIT licensed), which provided the initial Trakt OAuth scaffolding.

summary: A plugin that sync Trakt.tv watch history, ratings, and metadata into localized Markdown notes with detailed per-episode timestamps.
